overall.summary: 6 of 8 checks fail (Holdout split, Walk-forward analysis, Purged cross-validation, Deflated Sharpe ratio, Minimum backtest length, Parameter sensitivity): the selected setting's performance may well be an artefact of the parameter search.
overall.benchmark_summary: The checks ask whether the result could come from the search alone, not whether it beats the market: over the same dates the selected setting's Sharpe ratio was 0.23 against 0.64 for SPY buy and hold, and its annual return 2.5% against 10.8%.

holdout.title: Holdout split
holdout.summary: Picked on the first 70% of the history, the best setting's Sharpe ratio went from 0.25 to -0.11 over the remaining 10.1 years.

walk_forward.title: Walk-forward analysis
walk_forward.summary: Re-picking the best setting every 252 days on the previous 1260 days and trading it on the next period, it kept -11% of the in-sample return rate; the out-of-sample Sharpe ratio was -0.09.

purged_cv.title: Purged cross-validation
purged_cv.summary: Picking the best setting on 9 of 10 folds, with overlapping and embargoed days removed, gave an average Sharpe ratio of -0.33 on the held-out fold, against 0.28 on the folds it was picked on.

pbo.title: Probability of backtest overfitting
pbo.summary: In 30% of 12,870 ways to split the history into two halves, the best of 100 settings on one half ranked in the bottom half on the other.

deflated_sharpe.title: Deflated Sharpe ratio
deflated_sharpe.summary: With 100 settings tried (about 100 independent), the chance that the best one's true Sharpe ratio beats the 0.41 expected from the luckiest of them by chance is 15%.

track_record.title: Probabilistic Sharpe ratio
track_record.summary: Ignoring how many settings were tried, the chance that the selected setting's true Sharpe ratio is above zero is 91%; 51.9 years would be enough for 95% confidence.

min_backtest_length.title: Minimum backtest length
min_backtest_length.summary: With about 100 independent settings tried, luck alone produces a best Sharpe ratio of 0.23 in samples shorter than 123.4 years; this backtest covers 33.7.

sensitivity.title: Parameter sensitivity
sensitivity.summary: Settings next to the best one keep -151% of its Sharpe ratio of 0.23 on average.
